{{Quote|You were right. Someone faked the evidence. The recording presented to the Senate was ''not'' the full recording, but this disc ''is''. You must show the Senate.|Davu Golec|<ref name="DoM" />}}
'''Davu Golec''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Ministry of Intelligence/Legends|Ministry of Intelligence]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Born on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Golec became a close friend and associate of [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]], leader of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Though he worked as a bureaucrat and never considered himself to be a hero, Golec got his chance just the same when Duchess Kryze journeyed to Coruscant in order to argue against the Republic [[Mandalore Defense Resolution/Legends|occupation plans]] for Mandalore. Golec discovered the testimony from a [[Jerec/Legends|leading member]] of the New Mandalorian government had been falsified, and he risked his life and career in order to bring the evidence of the ruse to Kryze. However, Kryze had been followed to Coruscant by a [[Unidentified Death Watch assassin/Legends|member]] of the radical [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] splinter group, [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], with intentions to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Kryze. When the Death Watch [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] found Kryze meeting with Golec, he fired a [[Blaster/Legends|shot]] from his [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]] that pierced Golec's chest, killing him. Golec's sacrifice would prove not to be in vain, for when the evidence he provided was presented to the members of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], the [[Senator/Legends|senators]] chose to allow Mandalore its desired neutrality.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Where did you get this?''"<br />"''Buried, deep in the evidence facility at the Ministry. It was not easy to find, believe me.|Satine Kryze and Davu Golec|<ref name="DoM" />}}
Davu Golec was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TCWCE" /> As an adult, Golec joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Ministry of Intelligence/Legends|Ministry of Intelligence]], and at some point came to be a friend and associate of [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]], leader of the peaceful [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].<ref name="DoM" /> By the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]—a galaxy-encompassing conflict waged between the Republic and the forces of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]—Golec worked as a [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic intelligence]] bureaucrat, employed to [[Spy/Legends|monitor]] intercepted transmissions in order to assist the Republic's war effort.<ref name="NewBattlefronts" />

[[File:GolecMeetingWithKryze.png|thumb|left|250px|Davu Golec risked his life to deliver the evidence to Satine Kryze.]]
When the Republic drafted a [[Mandalore Defense Resolution/Legends|defense initiative]] that would send a contingent of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to the planet Mandalore in order to help combat the threat that the radical [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] splinter group known as the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] posed to the world's continuing peace, Golec's friend, Duchess Kryze, traveled to Coruscant in order to plead her case against such a move to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. In the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate hall]], Kryze proclaimed that Republic intervention in Mandalorian affairs would only make the situation on Mandalore worse, but [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] presented a [[Hologram/Legends|holorecording]] of the New Mandalorian [[Deputy Minister/Legends|Deputy Minister]], [[Jerec/Legends|Jerec]], stating just the opposite and demanding Republic assistance. While Kryze was shocked that her trusted friend would say such things, Golec found the truth:<ref name="DoM" /> the transmission from Jerec had been edited in order to change its meaning. Realizing the importance of the information he had uncovered, Golec copied the true recording despite not knowing who had altered it in the first place, and arranged to meet with Kryze to deliver the evidence in the hopes of averting further warfare.<ref name="NewBattlefronts" />

[[File:DeadDavu.png|thumb|right|250px|Golec paid for Mandalore's continued neutrality with his life.]]
Golec's actions did not go unnoticed; as he crept into the streets of Coruscant to meet with Kryze, Golec believed he was being followed. When the two met in an alley, he rushed to pass off the [[Datachip/Legends|datachip]] to Kryze and urged her to take the evidence before the Senate. Kryze scarcely had time to thank Golec before a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolt fired from the [[Sniper rifle/Legends|rifle]] of a [[Unidentified Death Watch assassin/Legends|Death Watch assassin]] struck him in the chest, [[Death/Legends|killing]] him almost instantly. As Kryze drew her [[Deactivator hold-out pistol/Legends|own weapon]] to defend herself against the [[Assassin/Legends|assailant]], a [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] [[Police probe/Legends|police probe]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] came upon the scene and mistaken took Kryze to be Golec's killer. Desperate to escape and present the evidence Golec had died to bring her, Kryze fled. She managed to make contact with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who passed the evidence on to Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], and it was she who delivered Deputy Minister Jerec's true message to the Senate while Kryze turned herself in. Kryze was vindicated of Golec's murder, and the evidence he provided caused the Senate to vote against sending [[Troop/Legends|troops]] to Mandalore.<ref name="DoM" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You've put yourself in great danger. I'll never forget it.''"<br />"''I had to come. This is worth it.|[[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] and Davu Golec, on risking his life for [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]|<ref name="DoM" />}}
As a [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] bureaucrat, Davu Golec had never desired to be a hero. He was familiar with the old adage that truth was often the first casualty in war, however, and the knowledge that the government he served was falsifying evidence greatly disturbed him.<ref name="NewBattlefronts" /> A supporter of Duchess Satine Kryze and the peaceful New Mandalorian faction which she ruled,<ref name="SWArchive-''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Duchess of Mandalore">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode214.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Duchess of Mandalore}}</ref> Golec was willing to risk his life in order to keep the Republic from invading her world, believing himself to be the only one who could avert another war between the Republic and the Mandalorians. Despite not knowing who had falsified the recording from New Mandalorian Deputy Minister Jerec, Golec mades up his mind to thwart them by delivering the true recording to Kryze.<ref name="NewBattlefronts" />
